rules.title: Pure Web Platform (Vanilla JS + HTML5 + CSS3 + Web Audio + Cloudflare)
rules.rationale: Zero-card $0 permanent hosting, sub-5% CPU OBS Browser Source efficiency, instantaneous loading without hydration overhead.

rules.title: Zero Custody & 100% Free Spectator Participation
rules.rationale: Strict compliance with Kick ToS and gambling regulations. No buy-ins, no custody of viewer crypto/fiat. Prizes awarded out-of-band.

rules.title: OBS Browser Source CPU Impact <= 5%
rules.rationale: HP 250 G8 notebook constraint. All animations must use composite-only properties (transform, opacity) via WAAPI and procedural audio.

rules.title: Tolerant Multi-Locale Number and Currency Parsing
rules.rationale: Parse both European and US number formats (1.500,50 vs 1,500.50) and multiplier suffixes (k, m, b) correctly.

rules.title: Cloudflare Durable Objects WebSocket Hibernation API
rules.rationale: Zero-cost real-time message broadcasting without billing active worker CPU during idle websocket connections.

rules.title: Rainbet Casino Scraper & Referral Engine
rules.rationale: Rainbet is no longer the active sponsor. The project operates exclusively with Stake VIP referral linking and DiggityBets virtual $DIG economy.

rules.title: Expo SDK & React Native Mobile Frameworks
rules.rationale: Belongs exclusively to Yendo Mobile. HuntHub / DiggityBets is strictly a Web Application and OBS Streaming Suite.

rules.title: Linear Line-by-Line AST Scanning (Zero ReDoS)
rules.rationale: Nested regular expression quantifiers (e.g. `([^()]*|\([^()]*\))*`) cause catastrophic backtracking and terminal freezes on large files (>2,000 lines). Parse class methods linearly with line splitting.

rules.title: Catch-All 200 OK JSON Fallback for Local API Testing
rules.rationale: Headless Playwright audits capture all 404 network failures as console errors. Local simulation servers must implement a catch-all 200 OK JSON fallback for `/api/*` to guarantee a clean 0-error report.

rules.title: Mandatory AbortSignal.timeout on External API Calls
rules.rationale: External API services (Serper, Qdrant Cloud, Vertex AI) can hang indefinitely when connection pools saturate or sockets drop. Every remote fetch must have an explicit timeout between 2,500ms and 3,500ms.

rules.title: Method Renaming Aliases on Class Prototypes
rules.rationale: When refactoring methods in public client controllers, provide a prototype alias to prevent runtime PAGEERROR exceptions when older modules or event handlers invoke the previous symbol name.

rules.title: Canonical Production Domain is strictly https://diggitybets.vip/
rules.rationale: https://diggitybets.vip/ is the single source of truth and production URL for the channel. Temporary workers.dev subdomains (*.workers.dev) generated by ephemeral preview builds must never replace or supersede the official domain.
